action: As Pagès's customer email is reported to advise, customers who bought on the site in the exposed window should watch for phishing messages that use personal details.
date_note: Date of the Cyberattaque.org article; the page gives no earlier day for the customer email.
exec: Pagès told customers, per Cyberattaque.org, that a flaw at a technical provider led to customer contact details and order histories being exposed.
geo_basis: headquarters or base as stated by the source (Le Puy-en-Velay)
plain: French tea brand Pagès told customers, according to Cyberattaque.org, that an attacker exploited a flaw at one of its technical providers, and customer names, addresses, emails, phone numbers and order histories were exposed.
summary: Cyberattaque.org, citing a customer email from Pagès it says it obtained, reports that an attacker exploited a vulnerability at one of the company's technical providers. A malicious script was reportedly present on several online-shop pages for a few days in November. Pagès says names, postal addresses, emails, phone numbers and order histories were exposed, and that passwords and its servers were not.
title: Pagès tells customers a flaw at a technical provider exposed customer data on its online shop, per Cyberattaque.org

validation.note: Single publisher (Cyberattaque.org) relaying Pagès's customer email; the email itself was not read.
